_doc: The black mystery egg in the hatch scene (MysteryEgg, scripts/ui/mystery_egg.gd). pool: every small and medium wild species of docs/boki/ROSTER_50.md (no starters, no boss kin, no large or rideable ones); each draws with its rarity tickets from content/rules/boki_modes.json (a very rare one is 6x less likely than a common one). mutation_mult: the hatchling's roll on Mutations' base odds (x5 is about 1 in 4 with a mutation; the starter eggs don't roll).
